title: Two Years Later, Israel’s Last Hostages Return

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我凌晨4点半给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 七十年的太空探索。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想看看下一颗恒星之外有什么。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 一千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60份超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们大概是联盟中每年表现最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都用不同的起始词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝175年来一直致力于帮助您了解世界，并充分利用每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，获取nytimes.com/subscribe上的特别优惠。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Rachel Abrams and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的瑞秋·艾布拉姆斯，这是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Early Monday morning, thousands of people had already gathered in what's become known as Hostage Square in Tel Aviv.
sentences.zh: 周一清晨，成千上万的人已经聚集在特拉维夫被称为“人质广场”的地方。

sentences.en: So happy right now.
sentences.zh: 现在好开心。

sentences.en: I stayed awake all night.
sentences.zh: 我彻夜未眠。

sentences.en: Just to see it, everything.
sentences.zh: 就为了见证这一切。

sentences.en: It's amazing that everybody's coming back.
sentences.zh: 大家都能回来真是太棒了。

sentences.en: And news broke that the first group of hostages had returned to Israel, starting in exchange for Palestinian prisoners and detainees that was expected to begin later in the day.
sentences.zh: 新闻报道称，第一批人质已经返回以色列，作为交换，预计当天晚些时候将开始释放巴勒斯坦囚犯和被拘留者。

sentences.en: Over the past few days, the world has seen dramatic scenes unfold from Israel and Gaza.
sentences.zh: 在过去几天里，世界目睹了以色列和加沙发生的戏剧性一幕。

sentences.en: In Gaza, thousands of Palestinians are returning to their homes and their neighborhoods, and they're seeing firsthand the devastation that two years of war has brought.
sentences.zh: 在加沙，成千上万的巴勒斯坦人正在返回他们的家园和社区，他们亲眼目睹了两年战争带来的破坏。

sentences.en: As international journalists continue to wait for access to the Strip,
sentences.zh: 随着国际记者继续等待进入加沙地带的许可，

sentences.en: today, I talk with families of hostages and other Israelis in Hostage Square about this long-anticipated moment, and also with my colleague Isabel Kirshner
sentences.zh: 今天，我在人质广场与人质家属及其他以色列人谈论这个期待已久的时刻，也与我的同事伊莎贝尔·基什纳进行了交流，

sentences.en: about why the hostages have been so pivotal in the efforts to end the war.
sentences.zh: 探讨为什么人质问题在结束战争的努力中如此关键。

sentences.en: It's Monday, October 13th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月13日，星期一。

sentences.en: Gentlemen, we welcome you to Ben Guria International Airport here in Tel Aviv.
sentences.zh: 各位先生，欢迎来到特拉维夫的本-古里安国际机场。

sentences.en: And our arrival time is approximately 9...
sentences.zh: 我们的到达时间大约是9点……

sentences.en: As the ceasefire took effect in Gaza, I flew to Israel with Daily producer Claire Tennesketter to ask people how they're feeling and what they're thinking.
sentences.zh: 随着加沙停火协议生效，我与《每日新闻》制片人克莱尔·坦内斯凯特飞往以色列，询问人们的感受和想法。

sentences.en: So we just got off the plane.
sentences.zh: 我们刚下飞机。

sentences.en: We haven't even been walking maybe five minutes.
sentences.zh: 我们甚至还没走上五分钟。

sentences.en: And all along this very brightly lit hallway are pictures of the hostages.
sentences.zh: 在这条灯火通明的走廊两旁，全是人质的照片。

sentences.en: And within minutes of arriving, we started seeing reminder after reminder of the remaining hostages in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 抵达后几分钟内，我们就开始看到一个又一个关于加沙剩余人质的提醒。

sentences.en: It lists the ages of the hostages on some of these posters, and some of them are crossed out with new ages as they've, I guess, gotten older.
sentences.zh: 这些海报上列出了人质的年龄，有些被划掉了，换上了他们变老后的新年龄。

sentences.en: This guy, 34, crossed out, 35, crossed out.
sentences.zh: 这个人，34岁，划掉，35岁，划掉。

sentences.en: Now it says 36.
sentences.zh: 现在写的是36岁。

sentences.en: So as soon as we dropped off our luggage, we went straight to what's become the epicenter of the push to return the hostages to Israel, a place known as Hostage Square.
sentences.zh: 所以我们放下行李后，就直接去了那个已成为推动人质返回以色列核心地带的地方，即“人质广场”。

sentences.en: It's a concrete public plaza between an art museum and a public library, and it's across the street from the Israeli military's headquarters.
sentences.zh: 这是一个位于艺术博物馆和公共图书馆之间的混凝土公共广场，对面就是以色列军方总部。

sentences.en: And in the weeks and months following October 7th, this place developed into a sort of living, interactive memorial to the hostages that were taken on that day.
sentences.zh: 在10月7日之后的几周和几个月里，这个地方发展成了一种活生生的、互动的纪念地，纪念那天被劫持的人质。

sentences.en: What's going on over in this?
sentences.zh: 那边在进行什么活动？

sentences.en: So this is actually like a little synagogue.
sentences.zh: 这其实像是一个小型的犹太会堂。

sentences.en: There are big white canvas tents.
sentences.zh: 这里有巨大的白色帆布帐篷。

sentences.en: Some of them are for shade.
sentences.zh: 有些是用来遮阳的。

sentences.en: Some of them are sort of information booths.
sentences.zh: 有些算是咨询台。

sentences.en: The tent of prayer and good deeds.
sentences.zh: 祈祷与善行之帐。

sentences.en: T-shirts, hats, flags.
sentences.zh: T恤、帽子、旗帜。

sentences.en: And there are little pop-up stores selling T-shirts and books and pins.
sentences.zh: 还有一些快闪店，售卖T恤、书籍和徽章。

sentences.en: The yellow ribbons and, uh...
sentences.zh: 黄丝带，还有……

sentences.en: But the whole space has become a kind of remembrance area.
sentences.zh: 但整个空间已经变成了一个纪念区。

sentences.en: Can you tell us what you're doing?
sentences.zh: 你能告诉我们你在做什么吗？

sentences.en: I write a message for the hostages.
sentences.zh: 我为人质写了一条留言。

sentences.en: Every square inch of this place seems like it has a photo of a hostage or a message for them, or some kind of memento.
sentences.zh: 这个地方的每一平方英寸似乎都有人质的照片、给他们的留言，或者某种纪念品。

sentences.en: And there are other things that feel very specific to this place and to this war.
sentences.zh: 还有一些东西感觉非常具有这个地方和这场战争的特色。

sentences.en: There's a piano that anybody can come up and play, because one hostage loved to play the piano.
sentences.zh: 有一架钢琴，任何人都可以上去弹奏，因为有一位人质生前热爱弹钢琴。

sentences.en: Can you describe what we're looking at?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下我们看到的东西吗？

sentences.en: It's the remaking of the tunnel.
sentences.zh: 这是对隧道的重现。

sentences.en: And there's even kind of an interactive, artistic replica of a Hamas tunnel, where the hostages are believed to be held.
sentences.zh: 甚至还有一个互动的、艺术化的哈马斯隧道复制品，据信人质就被关押在那里。

sentences.en: I remember the tunnel from the last time I was in Israel, over the summer, when it felt so different.
sentences.zh: 我记得上次夏天在以色列时看到的隧道，那时感觉完全不同。

sentences.en: There was no hostage deal in sight.
sentences.zh: 当时根本看不到人质协议的希望。

sentences.en: The mood was somber and despondent, angry.
sentences.zh: 气氛阴郁、沮丧，充满愤怒。

sentences.en: But now, coming back...
sentences.zh: 但现在，回来之后……

sentences.en: We're very, very, very happy this war is coming to an end, and...
sentences.zh: 我们非常、非常、非常高兴这场战争即将结束，而且……

sentences.en: The mood was optimistic, and people were excited.
sentences.zh: 气氛变得乐观，人们都很兴奋。

sentences.en: We're so happy.
sentences.zh: 我们太高兴了。

sentences.en: So we celebrate.
sentences.zh: 所以我们庆祝。

sentences.en: So we are offering a free cake for everyone.
sentences.zh: 我们正在为每个人提供免费蛋糕。

sentences.en: Free cake.
sentences.zh: 免费蛋糕。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: The other remarkable difference...
sentences.zh: 另一个显著的区别是……

sentences.en: We really have to thank America for the deal, especially Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我们真的必须感谢美国促成这项协议，特别是唐纳德·特朗普。

sentences.en: ...was that there were outpourings of gratitude for President Trump and his role in brokering the hostage deal.
sentences.zh: ……人们对特朗普总统及其在促成人质协议中所扮演的角色表达了感激之情。

sentences.en: Can you tell me what your sign says?
sentences.zh: 能告诉我你的牌子上写了什么吗？

sentences.en: Thank you, President Trump.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，特朗普总统。

sentences.en: Because we want him to know that we are thanking him from the bottom of our hearts.
sentences.zh: 因为我们想让他知道，我们从心底里感谢他。

sentences.en: The square is where the families of the hostages have come since the beginning of the war, demanding that the military and the government bring their loved ones home.
sentences.zh: 自战争开始以来，人质家属一直来到这个广场，要求军方和政府把他们的亲人带回家。

sentences.en: And it's also where thousands of supporters and protesters have come to weekly rallies to show solidarity and support for those families.
sentences.zh: 这里也是成千上万的支持者和抗议者参加每周集会，表达对这些家庭的声援和支持的地方。

sentences.en: And so after we spent some time taking in the scene, we asked a few family members to talk to us about how they were feeling
sentences.zh: 在观察了一番现场情况后，我们请了几位家属谈谈他们的感受，

sentences.en: just hours before the final hostages were supposed to come home.
sentences.zh: 就在最后一批人质预计回家前的几个小时。

sentences.en: Tell us who you are and why you're here today.
sentences.zh: 告诉我们你是谁，为什么今天来这里。

sentences.en: I'm the brother-in-law of Omri Miran.
sentences.zh: 我是奥姆里·米兰的姐夫。

sentences.en: I've been a hostage for two years now.
sentences.zh: 他已经被扣为人质两年了。

sentences.en: We met Moshe Lavi in the lobby of the library along the square, where families of hostages sometimes go to get away from the crowds.
sentences.zh: 我们在广场旁的图书馆大厅见到了摩西·拉维，家属们有时会去那里避开人群。

sentences.en: And it was very important for the family.
sentences.zh: 这对家庭来说非常重要。

sentences.en: Moshe was wearing a t-shirt with a picture of his brother-in-law, Omri, holding up one of his two young daughters in the air.
sentences.zh: 摩西穿着一件T恤，上面印着他姐夫奥姆里的照片，奥姆里正把他的两个年幼女儿中的一个举在空中。

sentences.en: Omri has two young daughters.
sentences.zh: 奥姆里有两个年幼的女儿。

sentences.en: They were held captive themselves on that day with my sister, luckily rescued.
sentences.zh: 她们那天和我姐姐一起被扣为人质，幸运的是被救出来了。

sentences.en: And I'm hoping that this will end.
sentences.zh: 我希望这一切能结束。

sentences.en: I just arrived yesterday with my sister, Lishai, from D.C.
sentences.zh: 我昨天刚和姐姐利沙从华盛顿特区赶回来。

sentences.en: That's where we got the good news.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里收到了好消息。

sentences.en: And we rushed back here.
sentences.zh: 我们赶忙回到了这里。

sentences.en: And I'm very excited to finally conclude this chapter.
sentences.zh: 我非常激动，终于要结束这一章了。

sentences.en: When you think of Omri, do you have an image that comes to mind?
sentences.zh: 当你想到奥姆里时，脑海中会出现什么画面？

sentences.en: Omri, for me, is always going to be the smiling man who made my sister happy after difficult years.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，奥姆里永远是那个在经历艰难岁月后，让我姐姐感到幸福的微笑男人。

sentences.en: It's the love of her life.
sentences.zh: 他是她生命中的挚爱。

sentences.en: That's what I have in my mind, the smiling face, the bashful eyes, and the heart, this big heart that entered our family.
sentences.zh: 这就是我脑海中的画面：那张微笑的脸，羞涩的眼睛，还有那颗进入我们家庭的宽广的心。

sentences.en: If you had to guess, what do you think Omri's, the first thing Omri will want to do is when he gets home?
sentences.zh: 如果让你猜，你觉得奥姆里回家后最想做的第一件事是什么？

sentences.en: No, I don't want to suppose what he wants to do.
sentences.zh: 不，我不想去揣测他想做什么。

sentences.en: He didn't have a choice for two years.
sentences.zh: 他这两年没得选。

sentences.en: And ever since we received the news, our focus is now on preparations, from small things like preparing a bag
sentences.zh: 自从收到消息后，我们现在的重点是准备工作，从准备一个包这样的小事开始，

sentences.en: to a bag for Omri.
sentences.zh: 给奥姆里准备一个包。

sentences.en: Because when he arrives, he would want to see, wants to wear something that is not what terrorists forced him to wear.
sentences.zh: 因为他回来时，会想穿上不是恐怖分子强迫他穿的衣服。

sentences.en: Have you thought about the first thing you want to say to him?
sentences.zh: 你想过见到他时要说的第一句话吗？

sentences.en: Just a hug.
sentences.zh: 就是一个拥抱。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And primarily, I just want to see my sister and nieces hug him.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，我只想看到我姐姐和侄女们拥抱他。

sentences.en: And I'm not important for that.
sentences.zh: 我并不重要。

sentences.en: I hope they'll have that moment.
sentences.zh: 我希望她们能拥有那一刻。

sentences.en: And I hope it will be the most beautiful moment in their life.
sentences.zh: 我希望那将是她们一生中最美好的时刻。

sentences.en: Family members like Moshe are in so many different situations.
sentences.zh: 像摩西这样的家属处境各不相同。

sentences.en: Some of them are waiting for hostages they know are alive.
sentences.zh: 有些人正在等待他们知道还活着的人质。

sentences.en: For others, they don't know.
sentences.zh: 对另一些人来说，他们不知道。

sentences.en: They're uncertain.
sentences.zh: 他们感到不确定。

sentences.en: And it's unclear how much hope they should have.
sentences.zh: 也不清楚他们该抱有多少希望。

sentences.en: But still, they hope to be on the cusp of some kind of ending.
sentences.zh: 但他们仍然希望处于某种结局的边缘。

sentences.en: It's a difficult day.
sentences.zh: 这是艰难的一天。

sentences.en: Another person we met at Hostage Square who had a family member go missing during the war was Ruby Chen.
sentences.zh: 我们在人质广场遇到的另一位在战争期间有家人失踪的人是鲁比·陈。

sentences.en: I'm a New Yorker.
sentences.zh: 我是个纽约人。

sentences.en: Grew up in Flatbush.
sentences.zh: 在弗拉特布什长大。

sentences.en: And I met my wife in Israel.
sentences.zh: 我在以色列遇到了我的妻子。

sentences.en: And we decided to have a home here.
sentences.zh: 我们决定在这里安家。

sentences.en: Ruby and his wife raised their three kids in Israel, but would frequently travel to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 鲁比和妻子在以色列抚养了三个孩子，但经常去美国旅行。

sentences.en: My eldest inherited my love for the New York Knicks and Itai as being the middle son, the more rebellious one.
sentences.zh: 我的长子继承了我对纽约尼克斯队的热爱，而伊泰是二儿子，比较叛逆。

sentences.en: He decided to be a Celtics fan, for the love of God.
sentences.zh: 天哪，他竟然决定成为凯尔特人队的球迷。

sentences.en: I don't know how that happened, but I feel that I failed as a father.
sentences.zh: 我不知道那是怎么发生的，但我感觉作为父亲我失败了。

sentences.en: And when the war broke out, one of his sons, Itai, the one with the rebellious streak, was performing his mandatory military service.
sentences.zh: 战争爆发时，他的一个儿子伊泰，那个比较叛逆的，正在服强制兵役。

sentences.en: And he, unlike his elder sibling that went to a technology unit, he, of course, decided to do something totally different, and he wanted to go into combat.
sentences.zh: 和去技术部队的哥哥不同，他当然决定做完全不同的事情，他想去战斗部队。

sentences.en: And he joined the tanks division.
sentences.zh: 他加入了坦克部队。

sentences.en: And he, on that fatal October 7th, was on the border of Gaza at a base called Nahal Oz,
sentences.zh: 在那个致命的10月7日，他在加沙边境一个叫纳哈尔奥兹的基地，

sentences.en: which is kind of in the middle of the Gaza Strip.
sentences.zh: 那地方就在加沙地带中部。

sentences.en: And they were ambushed.
sentences.zh: 他们遭到了伏击。

sentences.en: And they got hit by a few anti-tank missiles, and the tank was neutralized.
sentences.zh: 他们被几枚反坦克导弹击中，坦克瘫痪了。

sentences.en: And we were totally in the dark.
sentences.zh: 我们完全不知情。

sentences.en: Monday, we went to the missing people command center that was put together by the police.
sentences.zh: 周一，我们去了警方设立的失踪人员指挥中心。

sentences.en: And they said, well, he's missing in action, meaning no one is able to identify him physically standing next to him.
sentences.zh: 他们说，他属于失踪人员，意味着没有人能确认他当时就在现场。

sentences.en: He wasn't in one of the hospitals.
sentences.zh: 他不在任何一家医院里。

sentences.en: And a few days after, we got notified that he is indeed a hostage in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 几天后，我们接到通知，他确实是加沙的人质。

sentences.en: And we're sitting there.
sentences.zh: 我们坐在那里。

sentences.en: And, okay, do you have anything else to tell us?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你还有什么要告诉我们的吗？

sentences.en: Where is he now?
sentences.zh: 他现在在哪里？

sentences.en: Oh, we don't know.
sentences.zh: 哦，我们不知道。

sentences.en: Okay, then we're doing the work.
sentences.zh: 好吧，那我们继续努力。

sentences.en: So they waited, hoping for a positive sign, desperate for information on how their son was doing.
sentences.zh: 所以他们等待着，希望能有积极的迹象，迫切想知道儿子的近况。

sentences.en: In March 24,
sentences.zh: 在3月24日，

sentences.en: we got another knock on the door.
sentences.zh: 我们又听到了一次敲门声。

sentences.en: Then, a few months later,
sentences.zh: 几个月后，

sentences.en: Ruby got a very different message.
sentences.zh: 鲁比收到了一个截然不同的消息。

sentences.en: When the idea concluded, based on intelligence,
sentences.zh: 根据情报得出的结论是，

sentences.en: that he most likely did not survive on October 7th.
sentences.zh: 他很可能没能在10月7日那天幸存下来。

sentences.en: And we asked, okay, where's the physical evidence?
sentences.zh: 我们问，好吧，那实物证据在哪里？

sentences.en: He says, oh, we don't have that.
sentences.zh: 他说，哦，我们没有那个。

sentences.en: So we understand, we looked at, I looked at the intelligence.
sentences.zh: 所以我们理解，我们看了，我看了情报。

sentences.en: I understand that most likely
sentences.zh: 我明白最有可能的是

sentences.en: Tai is not one of the 20,
sentences.zh: 泰（Tai）不在那20人之列，

sentences.en: but he is no less of a hostage.
sentences.zh: 但他同样也是人质。

sentences.en: You know, there's the missing holidays, you know, Thanksgiving to Hanukkah to, you know, Easter.
sentences.zh: 你知道，错过了很多节日，你知道，从感恩节到光明节，再到，你知道，复活节。

sentences.en: And just, you know, think of a family dinner, holiday dinner with a chair that is empty.
sentences.zh: 只要，你知道，想象一下家庭晚餐，节日晚餐，却有一张空着的椅子。

sentences.en: You know, Tai, going back to the Celtics, you know, now is the beginning of basketball season.
sentences.zh: 你知道，泰，回到凯尔特人队，你知道，现在是篮球赛季的开始。

sentences.en: We would be sitting on the couch, you know, thinking about and jabbing one another who has a better chance of winning the division title.
sentences.zh: 我们本会坐在沙发上，你知道，一边想着，一边互相调侃谁更有机会赢得赛区冠军。

sentences.en: And we will play NBA 2K, and he will play with the Celtics, and play with the Knicks.
sentences.zh: 我们会玩《NBA 2K》，他会用凯尔特人队，也会用尼克斯队。

sentences.en: He would, of course, beat me because he's much better at 2K than I am.
sentences.zh: 当然，他会打败我，因为他玩《2K》比我厉害得多。

sentences.en: And he's missing.
sentences.zh: 而他失踪了。

sentences.en: It is just as important to us
sentences.zh: 对我们来说，同样重要的是

sentences.en: to get Tai back.
sentences.zh: 把泰带回来。

sentences.en: And then we'll deal with the two options that we have, either being able to hug him, or it means that one chapter ended and we need to start another chapter of our family.
sentences.zh: 然后我们会处理我们面临的两个选择，要么能拥抱他，要么意味着一个篇章结束了，我们需要开启家庭的另一个篇章。

sentences.en: But we need to have that ending of this chapter.
sentences.zh: 但我们需要为这个篇章画上句号。

sentences.en: Some of the family members at the square have the answers that people like Ruby are dreading.
sentences.zh: 广场上的一些家庭成员有着像鲁比（Ruby）这样的人所恐惧的答案。

sentences.en: They know that their relatives are dead, but they come here for different reasons.
sentences.zh: 他们知道自己的亲人已经去世了，但他们来到这里有不同的原因。

sentences.en: They come to support other people.
sentences.zh: 他们来是为了支持其他人。

sentences.en: They come out of a sense of solidarity.
sentences.zh: 他们出于一种团结感而来。

sentences.en: They come because they understand what it means to wait for these kinds of answers and to finally get them.
sentences.zh: 他们来是因为他们明白等待这些答案并最终得到它们意味着什么。

sentences.en: Can you tell me to start just who you are and why you're here tonight?
sentences.zh: 你能先告诉我你是谁，以及为什么今晚会在这里吗？

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So my name is Karmit Palti-Katseer.
sentences.zh: 我叫卡米特·帕尔蒂-卡齐尔（Karmit Palti-Katseer）。

sentences.en: I'm the daughter of Rami Katseer, who was murdered on October 7th in Kibbutz Niroz.
sentences.zh: 我是拉米·卡齐尔（Rami Katseer）的女儿，他在10月7日于尼罗兹基布兹（Kibbutz Niroz）被谋杀。

sentences.en: My mother, Chana Katsir, was abducted from Kibbutz Niroz, and my brother, Elad, was also kidnapped from Kibbutz Niroz.
sentences.zh: 我的母亲查娜·卡齐尔（Chana Katsir）从尼罗兹基布兹被绑架，我的兄弟埃拉德（Elad）也是从尼罗兹基布兹被绑架的。

sentences.en: My mom returned after 49 days in captivity in Gaza, and my brother, Elad, was murdered in captivity, and his body was retrieved to Israel on April 2024.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈在加沙被囚禁49天后获释，而我的兄弟埃拉德在囚禁期间被谋杀，他的遗体于2024年4月被找回以色列。

sentences.en: When my mother came back, I remember when she was brought on a gurney and she looked, like, up, and she saw me and she saw my sister,
sentences.zh: 我记得我母亲回来时，她被担架抬着，她抬头看，看到了我，也看到了我姐姐，

sentences.en: and then I could see that she's looking
sentences.zh: 然后我能看出她在寻找

sentences.en: about the missing faces.
sentences.zh: 那些失踪者的面孔。

sentences.en: She couldn't see my father and she couldn't see my brother, and she asked me, where are they?
sentences.zh: 她没看到我父亲，也没看到我兄弟，她问我，他们在哪里？

sentences.en: And I have to tell her, like, on the first five minutes, she's with us,
sentences.zh: 我不得不告诉她，就在她和我们在一起的前五分钟里，

sentences.en: that my father, her husband, was shot to death, and that my brother...
sentences.zh: 我父亲，也就是她的丈夫，被枪杀了，而我的兄弟……

sentences.en: For me, it was good news.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那是好消息。

sentences.en: I told her mom, but, you know, the good news is that he's kidnapped and he's alive, and it's crazy that even considered to be a good news, but for us, it was a good news.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她，妈妈，你知道，好消息是他被绑架了，他还活着，虽然把这视为好消息很疯狂，但对我们来说，这确实是好消息。

sentences.en: I remember when they told us
sentences.zh: 我记得当他们告诉我们

sentences.en: that he's dead, so my mom, she was in the hospital at the time, and she told the officer that she wants her son, my brother, to be brought to her
sentences.zh: 他去世时，我妈妈当时还在医院，她告诉警官，她想让她的儿子，也就是我兄弟，被带到她身边，

sentences.en: so she can kiss him goodbye, and then the officer was shocked and he told her, like,
sentences.zh: 这样她就能吻别他，然后警官很震惊，他告诉她，

sentences.en: we can't bring him over.
sentences.zh: 我们不能把他带过来。

sentences.en: You can't kiss him goodbye because his body wasn't in a state that she could have done that, and it's awful because the sense of closure is not full because we don't get to have
sentences.zh: 你不能吻别他，因为他的遗体状况不允许这样做，这太可怕了，因为这种了结感并不完整，因为我们没能经历

sentences.en: these normal phases of grief and goodbye.
sentences.zh: 这些正常的哀悼和告别阶段。

sentences.en: Meanwhile,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: Karmit's mom was struggling more and more with her health, suffering from ailments related to her captivity.
sentences.zh: 卡米特的母亲健康状况日益恶化，饱受囚禁相关疾病的折磨。

sentences.en: She steadily declined and passed away last year.
sentences.zh: 她的身体每况愈下，并于去年去世。

sentences.en: It's a huge difference between what I've been through with my father or my brother or with her because with her, we have the opportunity and the privilege to say goodbye,
sentences.zh: 我和我父亲、兄弟或她经历的事情有巨大的区别，因为对于她，我们有机会也有荣幸去告别，

sentences.en: to say how much we love her, to hold her hands, for her not to feel alone for a second,
sentences.zh: 去说我们有多爱她，去握住她的手，让她一秒钟都不会感到孤独，

sentences.en: and we didn't have that with my brother and we didn't have that with my father, and this makes this feeling of closure very different.
sentences.zh: 而我们没能对我兄弟和父亲做到这一点，这使得这种了结的感觉非常不同。

sentences.en: The people here, the families, there are so many families who are anticipating having their loved ones returned.
sentences.zh: 这里的人们，这些家庭，有太多的家庭在期待着他们的亲人归来。

sentences.en: What does that feel like as somebody that also was in that position?
sentences.zh: 作为一个也曾处于那种境地的人，那是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I'm struggling all the time for 736 days today.
sentences.zh: 到今天为止，我已经挣扎了736天。

sentences.en: I'm fighting for the release of all hostages.
sentences.zh: 我一直在为所有人质的获释而战。

sentences.en: This is my main goal in life, and of course,
sentences.zh: 这是我生命中的主要目标，当然，

sentences.en: I'm so thrilled that it's finally happening,
sentences.zh: 我非常激动，这一切终于发生了，

sentences.en: but of course, like emotionally, it's so complicated because, you know, tomorrow people are going to hug their loved ones and I'm not going to have this hug forever.
sentences.zh: 但当然，在情感上，这非常复杂，因为，你知道，明天人们将拥抱他们的亲人，而我将永远无法再拥有这个拥抱了。

sentences.en: How do you think the country has changed?
sentences.zh: 你认为这个国家发生了怎样的变化？

sentences.en: And how much of that change is permanent?
sentences.zh: 这种变化有多少是永久性的？

sentences.en: And how much will go away when the war is over?
sentences.zh: 当战争结束时，又有多少会消失？

sentences.en: I feel that this war has been too much and too long and too devastating, both for Israelis and for Palestinians, for Gazan people.
sentences.zh: 我觉得这场战争太沉重、太漫长、太具破坏性了，无论是对以色列人还是对巴勒斯坦人，对加沙人民来说都是如此。

sentences.en: I feel like the loss and the ruins, both in Israel and in Gaza,
sentences.zh: 我觉得损失和废墟，无论是在以色列还是在加沙，

sentences.en: it will take years and decades to rebuild something new.
sentences.zh: 都需要数年甚至数十年才能重建新的东西。

sentences.en: I'm not talking about the, you know, the house or the homes or the neighborhoods.
sentences.zh: 我不是在说，你知道，房子、家园或社区。

sentences.en: I'm talking about the possibility of living
sentences.zh: 我是在说那种能够

sentences.en: one next to each other.
sentences.zh: 彼此相邻生活下去的可能性。

sentences.en: and I feel like there is a crisis of trust or of confidence between the Israeli people and its leadership.
sentences.zh: 我觉得以色列人民与其领导层之间存在信任危机。

sentences.en: So I feel that in the end of the war, none of us is feeling more safe and it's sad to say that.
sentences.zh: 所以我感到在战争结束时，我们谁都没有感到更安全，说出这一点很悲哀。

sentences.en: Coming up next, I speak with my colleague
sentences.zh: 接下来，我将与我的同事

sentences.en: Isabel Kirshner on what the return of the hostages means more broadly for Israeli society and for the end of the war.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔·基什纳（Isabel Kirshner）探讨人质获释对以色列社会以及战争结束意味着什么。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wena Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘（Wena Liu）。

sentences.en: I write the game
sentences.zh: 我编写了游戏

sentences.en: Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 《Connections》，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，也喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky and I create the game
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基（Sam Azersky），我每天负责制作游戏

sentences.en: Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis and I have this thing called Chromaesthesia.
sentences.zh: 《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》，我有一种叫做“联觉”（Chromaesthesia）的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你们刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Isabel, thanks so much for talking to us.
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，非常感谢你接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: We are speaking at this moment when there are enormous scenes unfolding, not just where you and I are in Israel, but also in Gaza where hundreds of thousands of people
sentences.zh: 我们此刻正在交谈，巨大的场景正在上演，不仅是在你我所在的以色列，在加沙也是如此，那里有成千上万的人

sentences.en: are going back to their homes and their neighborhoods which have been largely destroyed to try to figure out how to start rebuilding their lives and international journalists
sentences.zh: 正回到他们大部分已被摧毁的家园和社区，试图弄清楚如何开始重建生活，而国际记者

sentences.en: are still waiting for access to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 仍在等待进入加沙的许可。

sentences.en: We're not allowed in there.
sentences.zh: 我们不被允许进入那里。

sentences.en: In the meantime,
sentences.zh: 与此同时，

sentences.en: I wanted to come to Israel where there was this seismic event happening, which is the return of the hostages.
sentences.zh: 我想来到以色列，这里正在发生一件地震级的事件，那就是人质的回归。

sentences.en: So just to start, can you remind us who are the hostages as a whole?
sentences.zh: 那么首先，你能提醒我们这些人质整体上是谁吗？

sentences.en: Sure, Rachel.
sentences.zh: 当然，瑞秋（Rachel）。

sentences.en: So the hostages were taken captive during the Hamas-led attack on Israel on October 7th,
sentences.zh: 这些人质是在哈马斯领导的对以色列的袭击中被俘的，时间是10月7日，

sentences.en: And at the time, about 250 people were taken captive and taken back to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 当时，约有250人被俘并被带回加沙。

sentences.en: They included many civilians, women, children, grandparents, and some soldiers.
sentences.zh: 其中包括许多平民、妇女、儿童、祖父母和一些士兵。

sentences.en: In the intervening two years of war, we've had in the past two brief temporary ceasefires where some hostages were exchanged for some Palestinian prisoners from Israeli jails.
sentences.zh: 在随后的两年战争中，我们过去曾有过两次短暂的临时停火，当时一些人质被交换为以色列监狱中的一些巴勒斯坦囚犯。

sentences.en: And the women and children for the most part were returned.
sentences.zh: 妇女和儿童大部分已获释。

sentences.en: Some of the younger men who were considered to be in the most vulnerable states physically were returned.
sentences.zh: 一些被认为身体状况最脆弱的年轻男性也已获释。

sentences.en: And what we're expecting is early Monday morning for the 20 live hostages to all be returned more or less at the same time.
sentences.zh: 我们预计周一清晨，20名活着的人质将几乎同时全部获释。

sentences.en: Then mainly men, mostly young men, mostly civilians, and a small number of soldiers.
sentences.zh: 主要是男性，大多是年轻人，大多是平民，还有少数士兵。

sentences.en: And then the remains of 26 more people who were either killed or died in captivity.
sentences.zh: 然后是另外26名在囚禁中被杀或死亡的人的遗体。

sentences.en: Some are supposed to also be returned later in the day on Monday.
sentences.zh: 有些人预计也会在周一晚些时候被送回。

sentences.en: But the authorities have been saying that it will be much harder to locate all the remains.
sentences.zh: 但当局一直表示，找到所有遗体会困难得多。

sentences.en: Some might be buried in places that very few people know where they are.
sentences.zh: 有些人可能被埋在很少有人知道的地方。

sentences.en: And so it could take much longer to return all of them.
sentences.zh: 因此，将他们全部带回可能需要更长的时间。

sentences.en: Can you remind us,
sentences.zh: 你能提醒我们，

sentences.en: Isabel, how these hostage returns have worked in the past just mechanically and what is different about this time?
sentences.zh: 伊莎贝尔，这些人质交换在过去是如何运作的，从机制上讲，这次有什么不同？

sentences.en: Of course.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: So in the past, what we've seen largely are these ceremonies where Hamas militants would kind of in a show of force build a stage and bring out some of the hostages in small groups
sentences.zh: 在过去，我们看到的大多是这种仪式，哈马斯武装分子会为了展示力量而搭建舞台，并分小批带出一些人质，

sentences.en: surrounded by masked gunmen sometimes be made to wave to the crowd or to give little speeches.
sentences.zh: 周围有蒙面枪手，有时会被迫向人群挥手或发表简短演讲。

sentences.en: This time around we understand that Hamas is supposed to not be holding these ceremonies.
sentences.zh: 这一次，我们了解到哈马斯应该不会举行这些仪式。

sentences.en: So we might not see very much at the beginning but the idea is they will be handed over to representatives of the Red Cross in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 所以我们一开始可能看不到太多东西，但想法是他们将被移交给加沙的红十字会代表。

sentences.en: They will then be transported and handed over to Israeli military and will be brought over the border into an Israeli military base called Re'im which is in southern Israel
sentences.zh: 然后他们将被运送并移交给以色列军方，并被带过边境进入以色列南部一个名为雷伊姆（Re'im）的军事基地，

sentences.en: and that's where they usually get their initial checks to see what their condition is and are reunited with close family members and you know you ask what's different this time
sentences.zh: 在那里他们通常会接受初步检查以了解身体状况，并与亲近的家庭成员团聚，你知道你问这次有什么不同，

sentences.en: so much is different this time.
sentences.zh: 这次有太多不同了。

sentences.en: I mean for one thing these hostages have been in captivity for two years so nobody really knows what their condition is.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，首先，这些人质已经被囚禁了两年，所以没人真正知道他们的状况如何。

sentences.en: We've seen some hostage videos released by Hamas over the months where some have appeared extremely emaciated and skeletal and very very distressed and you know it's very unclear
sentences.zh: 几个月来，我们看到哈马斯发布了一些人质视频，其中一些人看起来极度消瘦、骨瘦如柴且非常非常痛苦，你知道，这很不清楚

sentences.en: what the condition will be of those coming out alive and for the
sentences.zh: 活着出来的人状况会如何，而且对于

sentences.en: Palestinians too the Israelis are releasing more than 200
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦人来说，以色列人正在释放200多名

sentences.en: Palestinian prisoners who were convicted of life terms for serious deadly attacks against Israelis plus almost
sentences.zh: 因对以色列人进行严重致命袭击而被判终身监禁的巴勒斯坦囚犯，外加几乎

sentences.en: 2,000 about 1,700 plus detainees from Gaza who were detained by Israeli forces during the war and brought to Israel so it's a very large landmark occasion on all sides.
sentences.zh: 2000名，大约1700多名在战争期间被以色列军队拘留并带到以色列的加沙被拘留者，所以这对各方来说都是一个非常重大的里程碑事件。

sentences.en: One of our producers
sentences.zh: 我们的制片人之一

sentences.en: Claire Tennisgetter and I spent last night
sentences.zh: 克莱尔·坦尼斯盖特（Claire Tennisgetter）和我昨晚，

sentences.en: Saturday night at Hostage Square where there have been weekly rallies in support of bringing the hostages home since the beginning of the war and last night was one of if not
sentences.zh: 周六晚上，在人质广场度过，自战争开始以来，那里每周都有支持带人质回家的集会，昨晚是，如果不是

sentences.en: the biggest crowd that has ever been there according to a bunch of different reports
sentences.zh: 有史以来规模最大的人群，根据各种不同的报道，也是最大的一次之一。

sentences.en: Can you talk about the significance of the hostages to the war and to
sentences.zh: 你能谈谈人质对战争和

sentences.en: Israeli society and how that's changed since the start of all of this?
sentences.zh: 以色列社会的重要性，以及自这一切开始以来，这种重要性发生了怎样的变化吗？

sentences.en: Well there's an ethos in Israel that's largely been nurtured through the
sentences.zh: 嗯，以色列有一种精神，很大程度上是通过

sentences.en: Israeli military which is a conscription army so you know most people in Israel their children or their siblings somebody they know their neighbors will be serving or will have
sentences.zh: 以色列军队培养出来的，这是一支征兵制军队，所以你知道，以色列大多数人的孩子或兄弟姐妹，他们认识的人，他们的邻居，都会服役或曾经

sentences.en: been serving in the military and the ethos because it's a so-called people's army particularly has been that you never leave soldiers behind in the field and there's been a feeling
sentences.zh: 在军队服役，这种精神，因为它是所谓的“人民军队”，特别强调绝不把士兵留在战场上，而且有一种感觉，

sentences.en: that's grown over the two years as these captives have languished longer and longer that the Israeli government had essentially abandoned these people and left them in the field so
sentences.zh: 随着这两年这些俘虏被关押的时间越来越长，这种感觉越来越强烈，即以色列政府基本上抛弃了这些人，把他们留在了战场上，所以

sentences.en: the square has become a kind of fulcrum of anger and frustration as successive rounds of hostage talks collapsed and ceasefires collapsed and this war seemed to be turning into
